column1:
Happy Animals, happy farm.
[ul]Calculated based on the three other stats.
[b]Skill XP[/b] & [b]Produce[/b] is multiplied by the Animal's [b]Happiness[/b].
Cannot go below [color=orange]0%[/color].[/ul]

[i]Happiness = Hunger * 0.3 + Comfort * 0.3 + Satisfaction * 0.4[/i]
Note: [b]Comfort[/b] is [color=green]1[/color] if >= [color=orange]75%[/color]
column2:
快乐的动物，快乐的农场。
[ul]根据其他三项属性计算。
[b]技能经验[/b]与[b]产出[/b]会乘以动物的[b]幸福度[/b]。
不会低于 [color=orange]0%[/color]。[/ul]

[i]幸福度 = 饥饿度 * 0.3 + 舒适度 * 0.3 + 满意度 * 0.4[/i]
注意: 若 [b]舒适度[/b] >= [color=orange]75%[/color]，则视为 [color=green]1[/color]
